name: Small Business Assistance Task Force Committee Meeting Agenda

Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Halt Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcast at wwwbeverlyhills.orqllive and on BH Channel 10 or Channel 35

above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycoundil(ö.beverIyhills.or.g and will also
be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City Council

be in-person at City Hall.

  AGENDA

  3. Olympics
